privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Akinaza is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. A shop's data — its clients, appointments, invoices and tax ledger — is kept in Akinaza's database in Canada, encrypted at rest, visible to that shop only. Client consent is recorded per purpose (Loi 25) and can be withdrawn; a client's personal information can be erased, while the invoices tax law requires are kept. When a merchant asks to prepare a tax return, the period's ledger is sent to Orazaka, Krizaka's engine, over HTTPS; nothing is filed or transmitted to any government. Nothing is sold or shared. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.

invoiced.name: Invoiced
invoiced.meaning: What you billed in the period, before taxes. A credit note takes away what it cancels.
invoiced.formula: Total of your invoices before taxes, minus your credit notes.

collected.name: Collected
collected.meaning: The money you actually received in the period, whatever the invoice date.
collected.formula: Total of the payments received in the period. Beside it: that total over what you invoiced with taxes.

toCollect.name: To collect
toCollect.meaning: What your clients still owe you today, on all your invoices.
toCollect.formula: Invoices with taxes, minus the payments received. The overdue part is those past their due date.

gstCollected.name: GST collected
gstCollected.meaning: The GST (5 %) your invoices charged in the period.
gstCollected.formula: Sum of the GST of your invoices in the period, credit notes taken off.

qstCollected.name: QST collected
qstCollected.meaning: The QST (9.975 %) your invoices charged in the period.
qstCollected.formula: Sum of the QST of your invoices in the period, credit notes taken off.

gstToRemit.name: GST to remit
gstToRemit.meaning: What you would pay to the government for the GST, if the period ended today. Akinaza prepares it; you file it.
gstToRemit.formula: GST collected on your invoices, minus the GST you may claim back on your expenses.

qstToRemit.name: QST to remit
qstToRemit.meaning: What you would pay to Revenu Québec for the QST, if the period ended today. Akinaza prepares it; you file it.
qstToRemit.formula: QST collected on your invoices, minus the QST you may claim back on your expenses.

margin.name: Margin
margin.meaning: What is left of your revenue after your expenses, before taxes. It does not count your pay or costs you did not record.
margin.formula: Invoiced before taxes, minus your expenses before taxes at the share used for the business.

appointments.name: Appointments
appointments.meaning: The appointments that took place in the period.
appointments.formula: Number of appointments marked as done.

noShows.name: No-shows
noShows.meaning: The appointments where the client did not come, out of those that were due.
noShows.formula: No-shows over done appointments plus no-shows.

lexicon.title: Lexique
lexicon.intro: The words of your figures, in plain language.

tpsTvq.definition: Two sales taxes you charge your clients and pass on to the government: the GST (5 %, federal) and the QST (9.975 %, Québec). You collect them; you remit what you collected minus what you paid on your own business expenses.

htTtc.definition: Before taxes is the price without GST and QST; with taxes is what the client pays. Your revenue is counted before taxes, because the taxes are not yours.

margin.definition: What is left of your revenue after your expenses, before taxes. Here it only counts the expenses you recorded: your pay, your tax on income and costs not entered are not in it.

collectedVsInvoiced.definition: Invoiced is what you billed; collected is the money you really received. The gap is what clients still owe you.

declarationPeriod.definition: The stretch of time (a month, a quarter or a year, depending on how you file) covered by one GST/QST return. Akinaza prepares its figures; you review and file the return yourself.

noShow.definition: An appointment where the client did not come and did not cancel.
